description.value: The Dunbar Branch is a neighborhood outpost of the Vancouver Public Library system, serving the quiet residential Dunbar-Southlands area of Vancouver's west side. As a free, publicly accessible municipal building, it offers a welcoming rest stop for touring cyclists moving through this part of the city. The branch sits on a low-traffic stretch of Dunbar Street, making it an easy detour off the north-south corridor.
